value.rationale: The primary work establishes general stability and an O(N^-2) small-W1 perturbation sufficient condition for maintaining the quadratic geometric rate. A complete exact two-metric finite-size profile over a natural alternating normal-measure family proves that the sufficient order is not necessary: order N^-1 Wasserstein differences can coexist with order N^-2 Hausdorff error. This is a structurally motivated boundary result valid for every even grid size and all admissible weights, with exact sharp constants and explicit transportation certificates; not a tiny numerical increment or generic regular-polygon exercise.
